public_methodology: Tempo- and opponent-adjusted efficiency; offense, defense and special teams; preseason priors; forward-looking rather than résumé-based.
distinctive_ideas: Sustainable/predictive performance; opponent adjustment; tempo adjustment; preseason priors that fade; roster continuity/returning production; recent history; recruiting/transfers; coaching-change effects.
2026_relevant_detail: 2026 preseason SP+ uses returning production, recent history, recent recruiting/transfers, and coaching-change effects. ESPN reported recruiting now only about 1-2% of the preseason formula.
what_to_copy: Architecture and feature philosophy, not proprietary formula or weights.
edge_desk_role: Primary adjusted-efficiency submodel + preseason prior family.
reproducibility: Partial: methodology public, exact production formula proprietary.

public_methodology: Predicted offense, defense and special-teams components; EPA framework; opponent adjustment; Bayesian regression; blowout capping; preseason prior declines as season evidence arrives.
distinctive_ideas: Unit-level latent strength; Bayesian updating; iterative opponent adjustment; priors from prior performance, returning starters/QB, recruiting and coaching tenure.
2026_relevant_detail: Methodology remains useful as an architecture even though the detailed public explainer is older.
what_to_copy: Bayesian/shrinkage architecture, unit decomposition, opponent adjustment, early-season priors, blowout dampening.
reproducibility: Partial: architecture public, exact implementation proprietary.

public_methodology: Evaluates non-garbage possessions, field position and opponent quality to assess how efficiently teams perform on possessions.
distinctive_ideas: Drive/possession unit instead of only play-level averages; field-position context; opponent adjustment; non-garbage filtering.
2026_relevant_detail: Possession-level view is complementary to EPA/play and helps avoid a single modeling lens.
what_to_copy: Drive-value and possession-efficiency features; scoring opportunity and field-position context.

system: Jeff Sagarin Predictor / Recent / Golden Mean
public_methodology: Predictor is score-based; Recent gives more weight to recent games; overall rating synthesizes multiple score-based views.
distinctive_ideas: Separate full-season score signal from recency-sensitive signal; retain starting priors rather than throwing them away.
2026_relevant_detail: Useful as an intentionally different score-based family inside an ensemble.
what_to_copy: Margin-based ridge/Elo/state-space challenger and recency view, not rankings themselves.

public_methodology: Public explanation emphasizes rushing, passing, scoring and play success, cleaned/contextualized for opponent and game situation, then weighted by predictive ability.
distinctive_ideas: Do fewer things but clean them better; contextualize opponent and game state; prefer predictive signal over descriptive noise.
2026_relevant_detail: Current Unabated material also notes Peabody blends ratings to regress model estimates toward the mean.
what_to_copy: Feature cleaning, opponent/game-state context, explicit regression to mean, restrained feature selection.

public_methodology: EPA is change in expected points from before to after a play; modern CFB feature engineering builds efficiency metrics from play context.
distinctive_ideas: Play-level value rather than raw yards; pass/rush splits; garbage-time handling; reproducible PBP-derived metrics.
2026_relevant_detail: cfbfastR published updated EPA documentation in September 2026.
what_to_copy: EPA/PBP pipeline and play-level feature generation.

public_methodology: Historical pregame rows with opponent-adjusted EPA, success, line yards, explosiveness, havoc, finishing drives, field position, Elo and talent; features based only on games played before each matchup.
distinctive_ideas: Point-in-time snapshots; opponent-adjusted features; leakage-safe game rows.
2026_relevant_detail: CFBD's published Model Training Pack describes 2016-2024 FBS games, Week 5 through postseason, 92 columns / 81 usable predictive features.
what_to_copy: Feature families and point-in-time schema. Acquire data through CFBD API/exports or your own pipeline.
reproducibility: High conceptually; actual pack/API access may require CFBD account/tier.

public_methodology: Forward selection with season-wise cross-validation over 29 systems and 5,925 games (2016-2024, excluding 2020) produced a five-system OLS metamodel.
distinctive_ideas: Diversity of models can add signal; season-wise out-of-sample validation; compare directly with opening/midweek/closing betting markets.
2026_relevant_detail: Selected systems: Dokter Entropy, Pi-Rate Bias, Keeper, ESPN FPI, Pigskin Index. Study found strongest incremental usefulness versus the opener, with value eroding toward the close.
what_to_copy: Ensemble-selection procedure and market-benchmark discipline, NOT the historical coefficients as production weights.

public_methodology: Compiles weekly predicted margins from dozens of CFB computer systems and betting lines, with historical archives and comparative results.
distinctive_ideas: External benchmark; model diversity; opening/current/closing comparisons.
2026_relevant_detail: 2026 weekly page includes FPI, FEI projections, Sagarin variants and many other systems.
what_to_copy: Use as an external benchmark/challenger source, not as ground truth.
edge_desk_role: Weekly benchmarking and meta-features, kept outside pure football features unless explicitly building an external-consensus challenger.
